text:
maria_support: fyi, customer 'AcmeAnalytics' reporting ~30% 502/504s for hosted inference since 09:12 UTC. Error traces show gateway timeouts to prefix-cache (redis) - auth failures and connection resets. Raising P1 if not mitigated. ticket: #SUP-78321 :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: looking. do we have metrics? stacktrace?

leo_runtime: seeing spikes on redis auth_fail_rate from 0 to 100% at 09:11:52 across prefix-shard-7. CPU/network OK. Redis logs: "ERR Client sent AUTH, but no password is set" and also "LOADING Redis is loading the dataset in memory"

irene_sre: weird — could be auth rotation or KMS outage. any recent key-rotations? check secrets-manager event stream.

maria_support: client impact: majority are 502 gateway from api-gateway -> inference-proxy -> prefix-proxy. customers seeing inference requests fail mid-stream. repro curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```
returns 502 with body "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection_failure"

ashley_prodops: found a secret rotate event at 09:10:58 for redis/pfx-auth in ksm-prod. rotation job retried and reported 401 from KMS. maybe new creds not propagated to prefix-proxy replicas.

sam_oncall: quick mitigation: roll back secret to previous version or temporarily switch prefix-proxy to use fallback creds. can we hotpatch env var? :eyes: 

leo_runtime: I pushed env REDIS_PASSWORD to prefix-proxy deploy group pfx-*/replica via k8s secret patch on pfx-proxy-rolling. restarting pods gradually to avoid thundering herd. PR: deploy-ci/4026

maria_support: thx. customer notified that we're investigating. asked for ETA.

irene_sre: also enabled read-only fallback to in-memory LRU cache for non-critical keys to reduce backend load. config snippet:
```json
{"prefix_cache": {"fallback_mode":"lru_memory","max_entries":10000}}
```

sam_oncall: monitoring auth_fail_rate -> dropping from 100% to 0% on shard-7 now. 5xx rate for hosted inference decreased from 28% to 3%. still watching. :thumbsup: 

maria_support: customer replied: errors subsiding, will re-open if they see anything. closing incident window but keeping PagerDuty on call for 2h. ticket updated SUP-78321.

deploy-bot: deploy-ci/4026 rolled out to pfx-proxy (6/6 pods). no regressions detected.

irene_sre: action items: 1) root cause RCA - KMS rotation race led to partial credential propagation; 2) add rollout delay and healthcheck between secret rotations and prefix-proxy restarts; 3) add telemetry to detect auth rotation mismatches; 4) run chaos test to rotate secrets in staging and observe fallback. I'll open a follow-up doc. assigning to @ashley_prodops and @leo_runtime.

maria_support: thanks all. I'll send customer postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
